experiment: Source-verified external SAT holdout before bounded 004D6 source proof and exact GF2 rank. This manifest does NOT itself authorize admitting external sources or claims of blind evaluation.

custodian.approval_procedure: Independent custodian must be identified and public key preapproved in a distinct committed frozen protocol BEFORE any source/model submission. External curator must independently control source selection, model escrow and release. Never accept receipt-provided keys as trust roots.

cohort_freeze_policy: Require precommitted exact original SHA256, signed SAT model SHA256, declared n/m, issuer provenance and external release timestamp in an immutable separate manifest prior to any 004D6 rank processing. No additions, exclusions, replacement or seed changes after opening input.
rank_method: Freeze existing exact 004D6 bounded-resolution operator, independent original clause DAG replay, exact GF(2) augmented/coefficient rank relative to source explicit XOR equations. No optimization or new SAT solver runs during intake.
admission: Only model verified against every exact original CNF clause AND original source and model SHA anchored to pre-release external signature with approved key. Separate explicit third-party administrative independence review required before blind Witness status.
negative_outcomes: Keep invalid, zero-rank, resource-limited or absent submissions in append-only log. Never count missing inputs as 0 new rank or as failure of algorithm.
proof_against_false_independence: Tests using self-generated ephemeral keys are SYNTHETIC only, not external Witness; Github-hosted CI on same account is NOT administratively independent.
future_benchmark_gate: Only independently admitted model-first positive independent GF2 rank candidates may proceed to separately preregistered matched cost comparison with strong native-XOR solver. No benchmark launched by this PR.
